For any string $w \in L$ with $|w| \ge 2$, say $w = 01$, we can choose $x = \epsilon, y = 01, z = \epsilon$. Then $y = 01$ can be pumped: $x y^i z = (01)^i \in L$ for all $i \ge 0$. The minimum pumping length is 2.
